SELECT DISTINCT d.number, di.code, wm.label, p.pack_number FROM document d JOIN disposition di ON di.target='RAN5' AND di.evidence_status='source_verified' AND di.scope='whole_document' JOIN resolution r ON r.id=di.resolution_id JOIN meeting wm ON wm.id=r.meeting_id AND wm.wg='RAN5' JOIN pack_member pm ON pm.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=pm.pack_id JOIN cr_modifies_section cm ON cm.cr=d.id JOIN section s ON s.id=cm.section_id WHERE d.target_release='Rel-19' AND d.spec='TS 38.521-4' AND s.release='Rel-19' AND s.clause='6.2A.3.1.1.3.3_1'

SELECT DISTINCT s.clause, od.number, di.code, wm.label, p.pack_number FROM document target JOIN cr_modifies_section tc ON tc.cr=target.id JOIN section s ON s.id=tc.section_id AND s.release='Rel-15' JOIN cr_modifies_section oc ON oc.section_id=s.id JOIN document od ON od.id=oc.cr JOIN disposition di ON di.target='RAN5' AND di.evidence_status='source_verified' AND di.scope='whole_document' JOIN resolution r ON r.id=di.resolution_id JOIN meeting wm ON wm.id=r.meeting_id AND wm.wg='RAN5' JOIN pack_member pm ON pm.cr=od.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=pm.pack_id WHERE target.number='R5-186468' AND od.id<>target.id AND od.target_release='Rel-15'

SELECT DISTINCT d.number, di.code, wm.label FROM cr_pack p JOIN pack_member pm ON pm.pack_id=p.id JOIN document d ON d.id=pm.cr JOIN disposition di ON di.target='RAN5' AND di.evidence_status='source_verified' AND di.scope='whole_document' JOIN resolution r ON r.id=di.resolution_id JOIN meeting wm ON wm.id=r.meeting_id AND wm.wg='RAN5' WHERE p.pack_number='RP-250731'

SELECT DISTINCT di.code, wm.label, p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting FROM document d JOIN disposition di ON di.target='RAN5' AND di.evidence_status='source_verified' AND di.scope='whole_document' JOIN resolution r ON r.id=di.resolution_id JOIN meeting wm ON wm.id=r.meeting_id AND wm.wg='RAN5' JOIN pack_member pm ON pm.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=pm.pack_id WHERE d.number='R5-203000' AND d.doc_type='CR' AND d.spec='TS 38.533'

SELECT DISTINCT p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting FROM document d JOIN pack_member pm ON pm.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=pm.pack_id WHERE d.number='R5-194984' AND d.doc_type='CR' AND d.spec='TS 38.521-4'

WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS (SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier=(SELECT id FROM document WHERE number='R5-236866') UNION SELECT rv.later FROM revision rv JOIN later l ON rv.earlier=l.id) SELECT DISTINCT d.number, di.code, p.pack_number FROM later l JOIN document d ON d.id=l.id JOIN disposition di ON di.target='RAN5' AND di.evidence_status='source_verified' AND di.scope='whole_document' JOIN pack_member pm ON pm.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=pm.pack_id
